newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weakens marginally on dollar.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weakens marginally on dollar.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee weakened marginally against the dollar but strengthened slightly against the pound on Thursday, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was fixed at a commercial bank mean rate of 19.925 to the dollar from 19.916 on Tuesday. Against the pound, the rupee was posted at a mean rate of 33.364 from 33.394 on Tuesday.
"The market is very quiet and the banks are in long forex positions," one dealer said.
Foreign exchange dealers said that little activity was expected as major international markets were closed.
